metadata.title: Ondas Just Built Autonomous Defense Powerhouse With This Major Acquisition

content.text:
By Karen Roman
Ondas Inc. (Nasdaq: ONDS) said it acquired DZYNE Technologies at $875.8 million, expanding its portfolio across multi-domain ISR, counter-UAS, precision strike, mission intelligence and autonomous systems for U.S. and allied defense customers.
Ondas Sentinel, a dedicated operating division created to integrate DZYNE and World View, will unify Ondas' growing U.S. portfolio of autonomous defense technologies, the company stated.
READ MORE
IPO Edge NYSE Firesides Scheduled for July 28
"The character of warfare is changing rapidly, and military advantage increasingly belongs to organizations capable of deploying autonomous systems at scale," said Eric Brock, Ondas Chairman and CEO. "DZYNE significantly strengthens Ondas' financial profile, adding substantial scale and revenue growth. DZYNE is EBITDA positive with a strong and growing margin profile, accelerating Ondas' path towards profitable, long-term growth."
